publication_year_note: Header prints Ambiente & Sociedade, São Paulo v. XV, n. 1, p. 93-109, jan.-abr. 2012; page 16 prints Submetido em 30/03/2012 and Aceito em 04/04/2012.
rationale: The full text (17 pages, Portuguese) is an interdisciplinary synthesis combining descriptive macro-indicators from IBGE/PNAD (2002-2009 state-level GDP per capita growth, percentages of permanent private households connected to water and sewage networks in Table 1, and a visual bubble plot in Gráfico 1) with narrative and descriptive summaries of four previously published case studies in Amazonas (Iauaretê, São Gabriel da Cachoeira, Mamirauá Sustainable Development Reserve, and Manaus). Although the text mentions municipal tariff structure in São Gabriel da Cachoeira (flat R$ 9.00 monthly fee) and private concessionaire coverage gaps in Manaus descriptively, it reports zero inferential statistical tests, regression models, correlation coefficients, odds ratios, standard errors, confidence intervals, or p-values anywhere in the article. Flagging quantitative synthesis eligibility is therefore overstated.
